title: Comment bcrypt cost factor 4 in e2e_smoke.rs test helper
description: In tests/e2e_smoke.rs, test_config() calls bcrypt::hash("testpass", 4). The cost factor 4 is the minimum accepted by the bcrypt crate and is used here to keep test startup fast, but there is no comment explaining this. A new contributor following the production default (cost 12) would not understand why 4 is used and might assume it is the recommended security level. A brief comment -- e.g. "cost 4 = bcrypt minimum, chosen for fast test startup" -- would prevent confusion.
